title: Pumpkin Blur Remover
description: Remove the carved pumpkin overlay for clear visibility.
body:
# Pumpkin Blur Remover

**Pumpkin Blur Remover** removes the black pumpkin blur from your screen when you wear a carved pumpkin.

This resource pack makes the pumpkin overlay completely transparent. It does not change any other textures or game mechanics.

##  Installation

### Java Edition
1. Download the resource pack zip file.
2. Open Minecraft and go to **Options** > **Resource Packs** > **Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded zip file into the folder.
4. Activate the pack in the in-game menu.

##  Availability
* **Java Edition:** Download right here on Modrinth!
